print_errors.note: The initial mim carries shadda+damma in print (expected مُظَفَّرًا). Kept as printed; checked at 1000 dpi. The same pattern occurs on p.064 (مُّؤَزَّرًا).
قَوِيٌ is printed with dammatan only, no shadda on the yeh (expected قَوِيٌّ). Checked at 1400 dpi. Kept as printed.
The ra of الْمُرسَلِينَ has no sukun in print, while the parallel words الْمُذْنِبِينَ and الْمُتَّقِينَ are fully vowelled. Checked at 2000 dpi. Kept as printed.
The ain of نعتك carries a fatha in print (expected sukun: وَنَعْتِكَ). Checked at 1600 dpi. Kept as printed.
The final ba of فاكتب has no vowel (kasra) in print. Checked at 1600 dpi. Kept as printed.
66:8 has no waqf sign ۖ after لَنَآ in print, although Tanzil has one. Checked at 1300 dpi. Not added. scripts/quran.py flags it (quran_marks).

notes: Markers: p.064 ends with a full sentence (…[آل عمران: ١٦٠].) on a short last line, and the first line of p.065 is indented, so p.065 has no '+'. p.066 starts with an indented new prayer. p.067 continues the 2:201 quotation begun at the end of p.066 (its first line is not indented), so it is <<<ص:067+>>>. p.068 starts with an indented new paragraph (Ayat al-Kursi). Paragraph breaks follow indents or short last lines. The text of p.066 para 4 starts after the short line «…شَفَاعَتِهِ.» without an indent. Cross-page Quran quote: the 2:201 quotation runs from p.066 into p.067. Because validate.py requires balanced brackets on every line, it is closed with ﴾ at the end of p.066 («﴿رَبَّنَآ ءَاتِنَا فِى﴾») and reopened with ﴿ at the start of p.067. Neither bracket is printed at the page break. Bold: the parenthesised invocations on p.065 «وَأَيِّدْنِي بِكَ لَكَ», «وَاجْمَعْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَكَ», «وَحُلْ بَيْنِي وَبَيْنَ غَيْرِكَ» and «الله. الله. الله» are printed bold. The parentheses themselves have the same stroke width as regular parentheses (measured 24 px at 1500 dpi in both), so they stay outside the markers: (**…**). The rest of pp.065-068 is regular weight. The word Allah: on p.065 the body-font ligature (shadda and small alif drawn automatically) also carries a printed damma, so following CONVENTIONS §2 (case vowel printed, «write them all», e.g. اللَّهُ) it is written اللَّهُ (6 times). The bold «(الله. الله. الله)» has no case vowel, so it is plain الله. Explicitly vowelled اللَّهُمَّ (shadda+fatha drawn) on pp.066-067 is written with marks. Dagger alif over final alef maqsura in the body font (حَتَّىٰ، عَلَىٰ، الْهُدَىٰ) is written ىٰ as printed. Quran (Tanzil encoding): the round silent zero on أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ، ءَامَنُوا۟، صَلُّوا۟، وَسَلِّمُوا۟، وَأُو۟لُوا۟ (checked at up to 2000 dpi; it differs from the khāʾ-head sukun). A hamza on a seat drawn below the tooth with kasra (ئِ in أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ، ٱلْمُطْمَئِنَّةُ، وَمَلَٰٓئِكَتَهُۥ، قَآئِمًۢا) is encoded ئِ as in Tanzil. Hamza on a kashida seat is kept as Tanzil ـَٔ / ـُٔ (فَـَٔامَنَّا، سَيِّـَٔاتِنَا، يَـُٔودُهُۥ). The lam-alif with hamza+fatha in الآخرة (2:201) is encoded ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ (Tanzil form, which looks identical in this font). The iqlab mim on قَآئِمًۢا and أَحَدٌۢ (112:4) is printed and encoded with tanween + ۢ. Waqf signs are transcribed where printed. The signs Tanzil has at the end of a quoted span (58:22 مِّنْهُ, 16:53 ٱللَّهِ, 28:85 مَعَادٍ) are not printed and not added. scripts/quran.py reports only those 3 and the 66:8 لَنَآ case (see print_errors). Basmalas before al-Ikhlas and al-Falaq on p.068 are written in the standard form outside the brackets, on the same paragraph line as printed. References: spacing after the colon follows the print ([المجادلة: ٢٢], [الفجر:٢٧-٢٨], [البقرة:٢٠١], [الممتحنة:٤], [الحشر:٢٢-٢٤], [التحريم:٨] without a space; the others with one). A space is always written between ﴾ and [ and before ﴿ (on p.067 «عَذَابِكَ﴿يَوْمَ» is set nearly touching). European digits on p.068 are kept: the print shows the block «1–5» (1 on the left, 5 next to the colon), so the logical order is written [الفلق:1-5] and [الإخلاص:1-4]. Measured gaps (about 1.5 pt after the colon, about 2-3 pt elsewhere, comparable to digit side-bearings) show no word space after the colon or between ] and (ثلاثا). So the refs are written «[الإخلاص:1-4](ثلاثًا).» and «[الفلق:1-5](ثَلاثًا).». This differs from the illustrative «[الفلق: 1-5]» in CONVENTIONS §2, so an adjudicator should check that spot. The two «ثلاثا» differ in print: the Ikhlas one has fathatan only, the Falaq one also has a fatha on the first tha. p.065 مَدَارِجِ: the kasra under the final jim is printed. It sits just above the shadda/damma of صَلُّوا۟ on the next line. Kashidas (e.g. لَـكَ، قَـوِيٌ، البقـرة، كَـتَبَ) are dropped. Ornament flowers on the Quran brackets, running heads and page numbers are omitted.
